comment: Hand-labeled seed questions over the pinned copy of the repository's own `examples/`. Its entry links two files, so the universe is small and several queries share an answer — the point here is the phrasing, not the breadth. Label a declaration `<file>#<name>`, or `<file>#<Type>.<method>`.

seeds.query: where is a new order put together?
what checks the things being bought before anything else happens?
where is the sentence an order shows to a person built?
which function adds up what the whole order costs?
where is the person who buys something declared?
which type describes one line of what was bought?
where are the states an order can be in listed?
what enumerates the ways this can go wrong?
which function reports the outcome as text?
where is an order value first constructed?
which type carries the whole purchase?
where is a purchase with nothing in it rejected?
what catches a price below zero?
where does the buyer's name live?
what wording is used once the money has arrived?
